description: copy.top is a non-custodial, multichain crypto copy-trading web app that lets users follow named traders from fomo and pump.fun from their own wallet. It also publishes public trader, coin, and research data, including Hyperliquid market coverage and weekly profitability statistics.
summary: copy.top exposes a public streamable-HTTP MCP server at https://copy.top/mcp; it works without authentication, and an optional free API key can be sent as a Bearer token to unlock extra tools and higher rate limits.
